analysis_population_accounting.note: The formal experiment execution produced 30 valid paired blocks. The primary analysis population contains 28 analysis-eligible pairs under the frozen/adjudicated population rule.

execution_valid_pairs.definition: Paired blocks where both AE and SE runs passed all validity gates

analysis_eligible_pairs.definition: Execution-valid pairs with complete primary endpoint data for both AE and SE

excluded_pairs_detail.exclusion_reason: Block 1 evidence carried forward from prior R2 execution - no primary endpoint data in current R2 execution freeze
excluded_pairs_detail.exclusion_authorization: Explicit special adjudication in canonical ledger

excluded_pairs_detail.exclusion_reason: SE primary endpoint data missing - SE run carried forward from prior execution, not rerun in R2
excluded_pairs_detail.exclusion_authorization: Frozen PAIR_EXCLUSION_RULE requires complete paired primary endpoint data for both runs
excluded_pairs_detail.note: AE retry executed with primary data; SE carried forward without primary data rerun

analysis_population_accounting.clarification: Do not interpret the 30→28 reduction as experimental failure. All 30 pairs executed successfully and passed validity gates. The 2-pair exclusion is due to documented special handling (carry-forward) that prevented complete primary endpoint data collection for those specific pairs.
